independence_instructions: This is an AI-assisted audit and does not satisfy the independent-human annotation requirement.
Use only public task, quality, scenario, metric, overlay, source, and test evidence.
Do not inspect reference branches, solution patches, or model-generated answers.
rationale: Marshmallow has genuine dependencies among registry/declaration, fields/validators, and schema processing/hooks. Nested fields and load/dump behavior can consume stale class-registration, field-binding, decorator metadata, and error-store contracts. The task is suitable in principle, but schema.py is currently writable by two agents and several collection overlays provide partial decorator or metaclass behavior; exclusive Worker-SVR claims require an explicit shared-ownership policy or a revised assignment before release.
